security_classification: READ_ONLY_BOUNDED_PRODUCT_PROJECTION; no network/parser/persistence/execution authority added; inputs are bounded and exact-key/typed where lane-owned.
authority_science_classification: ANALYSIS_ONLY graph over existing governed Scientific Fingerprint/state. Per-edge source/target/projection/effective authority is explicit; mixed paths downgrade. UNKNOWN and UNSUPPORTED fail closed. Presentation consequences and explanatory text never become scientific state authority.
performance_resource_evidence: Projection bounds default to maxNodes=256, maxEdges=512, maxCandidates=128, maxAssumptions=64, maxUncertainties=64, maxParameterBytes=4096; inspection defaults are separately bounded. Hosted witness used 44 nodes / 30 edges and a 49,358-byte canonical graph.
limitations: Upstream R6 currently exposes model-conditioned presentation influences, explicit non-influences and unknowns, not a complete source-backed scientific causal genealogy; this lane does not invent missing causal science.
Uncertainty is first-class only when explicitly supplied by an upstream/caller record bound to the exact subject/model; absence is NOT_DECLARED_UPSTREAM.
UNSUPPORTED is a lane-local fail-closed classification and does not amend the frozen W1 authority contract.
Permanent package.json registration is outside lane ownership and must be applied by control convergence.
The terminal handoff uses externally bound Draft PR final SHA/tree to avoid self-referential evidence mutation.

CORRELATES with explicitCausalClaim=true was rejected; CAUSES without explicitCausalClaim=true was rejected.

rollback_abandon_condition: If control review finds authority promotion, non-deterministic graph identity, protected shared-surface mutation, or a scientific causal relation not backed by explicit upstream/caller provenance, reject PR #314 and repair forward within SCI-WHY ownership; do not weaken W1 contracts or rewrite published evidence.
